system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided codebase for bugs, security issues, and correctness problems. Provide actionable feedback. All files are located in /tmp/files.
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze the ADK Java codebase. Identify subtle bugs, security regressions, data consistency issues, ordering problems, and time/precision flaws. Focus on issues detectable via static analysis. Write your findings to /tmp/outputs/review.md.

rubric.criterion: Identifies the stale session usage in core/src/main/java/com/google/adk/runner/Runner.java within runAsync(Session, Content, RunConfig, Map) where runAgentWithFreshSession is called with the original session instead of the freshly retrieved updated session, causing stateDelta updates to be ignored by the agent

Identifies the stateDelta aliasing bug in core/src/main/java/com/google/adk/runner/Runner.java within appendNewMessageToSession where the EventActions stateDelta can reuse the caller-provided map without copying, allowing later mutations to retroactively change persisted session state

Identifies the live audio transcription regression in core/src/main/java/com/google/adk/runner/Runner.java within newInvocationContextForLive where inputAudioTranscription is no longer set for live runs, breaking agent transfer and tool flows that rely on input transcripts

Identifies the duplicate LLM call risk in core/src/main/java/com/google/adk/flows/llmflows/BaseLlmFlow.java in the run method where the step Flowable is no longer cached, causing the flow to re-execute (and re-call the model) when the events are re-consumed

Identifies the tool execution ordering bug in core/src/main/java/com/google/adk/flows/llmflows/Functions.java within handleFunctionCalls where SEQUENTIAL mode now uses concatMapEager (parallelized execution), breaking tools that depend on order or shared state

Identifies the confirmation bypass in core/src/main/java/com/google/adk/tools/FunctionTool.java within runAsync where a missing tool confirmation no longer blocks execution, allowing tools marked requireConfirmation to run without approval

Identifies the timestamp precision bug in core/src/main/java/com/google/adk/sessions/InMemorySessionService.java within getSession where afterTimestamp filtering compares event.timestamp() (milliseconds) directly to Instant.getEpochSecond(), causing incorrect event filtering

Identifies the API contract drift in core/src/main/java/com/google/adk/sessions/SessionJsonConverter.java within convertEventToJson where the long running tool IDs key is emitted as longRunningToolIds instead of long_running_tool_ids, losing data on deserialize
